claimText: Historical rule (Academic Integrity Policy 2022 as described in the Teaching@Sydney FAQ): students could only use assistance, including automated writing tools, if the unit of study outline expressly permitted it. Current student guidance (updated 2 June 2026) instead allows AI in open assessments and generally prohibits it in secure assessments unless expressly permitted, so this undated prior-permission rule is held as historical and not shown as a current university-wide rule. The current Policy Register text was not re-read clause by clause.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Clause 5(16) (2) mentions that students may only use assistance, including automated writing tools, if the unit of study outline expressly permits it. (5)(b) mentions that students must acknowledge assistance provided when preparing submitted work, including the use of automated writing tools.
